👋 About Me#I am an Aspiring Cloud Support Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS cloud services, system monitoring, and automation. I have built and maintained cloud infrastructure through personal projects using Terraform, CloudFormation, and Docker, and I am comfortable automating tasks using Python, Bash, and AWS CLI.
I have real-world exposure to Base24 Switch and ATM systems, system monitoring, and incident management, with a strong focus on reliability, uptime, and operational excellence. My goal is to transition into a full-time Cloud Support / Cloud Engineer role while continuously improving my cloud and DevOps skills.

Automated issue detection and log monitoring, achieving 99.9% system uptime. Used SQL-based OS queries for system analysis, reporting, and proactive issue detection.
